subject: biologie
scope: Independent SOURCE decision on six removed mappings in three whole pairs, preserved source objects and partners, actual primary pages, and two HH page-context changes

independence.inputsUsed: Sealed neutral entry, manifest and byte bindings; actual whole source extraction/mapping objects, whole current canonical partners and models; complete selected official PDF pages and visible primary/native raster pages. Source mapping records are the objects under review, not accepted judgments.

acceptedRemovalDecisions.primary: HB 2006 physical/printed page 30, process competencies, read in full and viewed as an actual original-page raster; 2022 restriction read and biology pages 1-3 viewed.
acceptedRemovalDecisions.reason: The primary requirement concerns reflecting on disgust when handling natural objects. It does not require conducting and documenting investigations or evaluating the scope of scientific inquiry. The actual canonical descriptions have those distinct operators and objects. Both partial mappings were unsupported and should be removed. Keeping the source requirement with needs_canonical_goal and no targets is an honest unresolved obligation.

acceptedRemovalDecisions.primary: HB 2006 physical/printed page 31, complete Sinne und Wahrnehmung and neighboring Sexualität und Verantwortung context; 2022 restriction pages 1-2.
acceptedRemovalDecisions.reason: The official operator is naming alcohol/drug effects and strategies to avoid substance misuse. The removed whole cluster and its three children demand observation/releasers, genetic and acquired behavior, and conditioning. Broad behavioral subject overlap does not establish those competencies. The removed inherited witnesses must disappear without altering independent valid sources for the three child goals. Stronger erklären/ableiten wording stays explicitly authored operationalization, not the official operator.

acceptedRemovalDecisions.primary: HH 2011 physical/printed pages 24, 27 and 28, complete page text and rotated table pixels viewed; page 24 distinguishes grade-8 communication from transition-to-Studienstufe communication.
acceptedRemovalDecisions.reason: Describing/explaining how drugs affect the nervous system contributes physiology. The actual pages do not establish life skills for coping, satisfaction and personality development, or the boundary between enjoyment and addiction with conscious perception of personal addiction risks. Generic topic wording and health headings cannot fill those operator/object gaps. Removing both mappings, contribution scopes and HH memberships is correct. The surviving 773a297d physiology partial record remains byte-identical and bounded.

acceptedRemovalDecisions.primary: SL 2012 physical/printed pages 25-26, complete introduction and both competency columns viewed.
acceptedRemovalDecisions.reason: The material concerns seed plants and sexual/asexual propagation, flower parts, pollination, fertilization, fruit and seeds in grade 5. The actual canonical partner compares reproductive strategies of birds or fish. A shared reproduction label cannot supply the required animal comparison. Retain only the existing flower-function partial partner and remove the animal target from metadata and the mapping. The extraction's stronger composite erklären wording is authored synthesis of several official nennen/angeben/darstellen requirements, not a verbatim bullet or proof of full coverage.

preservedSourceScopeDecisions.reason: Actual page 31 describes mitosis/meiosis as genetic information transfer. The canonical goal describes mitosis, simplified meiosis and gamete formation. This provides genuine partial overlap. Retain the official beschreiben operator, authored stronger operationalization distinction and 2022 grade-5-9 scope; do not infer puberty-media judgment or year-10 validity.

This is the separate official dissection/possible-disgust requirement. Practical eye investigation gives content overlap with eye structure and practical investigation. It is not interchangeable with the standalone HB037 requirement and does not by itself explicitly demand every documentation/evaluation operator in the retained canonical methods partners. Retention preserves the exact old partial evidence; this bounded removal review gives those partners no new full approval. The extracted wording paraphrases the primary's auseinandersetzen wording; primary authority remains the actual PDF.

Naming effects and avoidance strategies supplies limited overlapping health/addiction subject matter. It does not alone prove stronger modeling, personal-risk awareness, weighing decisions or life-skill derivation. The six-record candidate changes only the unsupported behavior cluster mapping. Unchanged remaining partners retain their historical partial status and need their existing evidence boundaries.

The grade-8 beschreiben and transition erklären distinction and domain Biologie des Menschen match the original communication table. Physiological drug effects contribute to this broader canonical addiction goal without proving a complete biopsychosocial development model or full prevention competence. Other 32 unchanged Hamburg partners receive no fresh whole-course clearance, including canonical goals whose own tags are LK/Q2. Source jurisdiction and stage come from the source/view context, not from title overlap or canonical phase.

Page 26 names typical flower parts and their functions, directly overlapping the flower-function goal. The source includes further fertilization/fruit/seed content, so this retained partial mapping does not certify full source-duty coverage.
